sources: Sanitized user messages and structured helper receipts from the room session record
Human OFF confirmation reported by coordinator
primary_evidence.initial_intent: Guest requested a light/music performance with synchronization; no tempo change or stop was requested.
observed_native_actions: Stop program; phone cleanup UNKNOWN, audio confirmed
fresh_guest_off_receipts: Raw OFF denied CONFLICT by the program reservation
Detach denied STOPPED because the program was no longer running
primary_evidence.subsequent_guest_off_attempt: Guest explicitly requested access to turn off the performance; agent read inventory/status, found an unknown reserved phone, and sent no OFF command.

independent_aggregate_reset_failure.meaning: Known unsent queue timeout behind Mac narration; does not negate the phone OFF acknowledgment.

diagnosis.documented: An unknown stopped program kept its phone reservation; a fresh authorized guest OFF had no recovery route. Repeated stop reused the old cleanup outcome.
diagnosis.offline_reproduced: Canceling an already-dispatched phone ON at stop creates Bus uncertainty; cleanup OFF is blocked. A later exact ON acknowledgment clears uncertainty, but the old program claim still blocks fresh raw OFF.
diagnosis.unproven_live_trigger: The specific canceled in-flight edge causing the first live UNKNOWN was not recorded. The offline reproduction proves a source defect, not that exact live trigger.

repair_contract.graceful_stop: Immediately invalidate future ON authority; allow only an already-dispatched bounded phone action or audio status read to settle before owned cleanup.
repair_contract.fresh_explicit_off: Current guest permission, exact connection and a fresh helper request authorize one absolute OFF after prior phone work and Bus uncertainty settle. No uncertainty bypass, automatic retry or ON replay.
repair_contract.recovery: Only the actual matching OFF acknowledgment releases the matching claim. Unknown outcomes stay reserved and provide local camera-disconnect guidance.
repair_contract.parallelism: A fresh guest explicit phone OFF does not wait for unrelated Mac cleanup or narration.
repair_contract.host_reset_limit: Aggregate host reset still awaits program quiescence before its cleanup hook. It can wait for audio in an unknown-phone case; this patch makes no all-case fast-reset promise.
repair_contract.model_behavior: Live guest dialogue is a performance, not a rehearsal. Do not change tempo or stop an ongoing performance unless requested.

remaining_physical_gates.timed_expiry_test: INTERRUPTED by explicit user stop; not PASS
